reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, store_type,
       CASE WHEN store_type = 'flagship' THEN 'big'
            WHEN store_type = 'outlet' THEN 'small'
            WHEN store_type = 'web' THEN 'online'
            ELSE 'regular'
       END AS store_format
FROM stores
